_about: Claude's drafts of rulers' lines, for Rich to review (D-62). Development builds show them beside rivalLines.json; release builds never do. To approve a line, move it into rivalLines.json under the same ruler and key (and edit it as you like). Patch 8's drafts were all approved and moved there on 2026-10-31 (D-67). Placeholders: {hex} a hex's name, {rival} a ruler's short name, {days} a span such as 'a day' or '2 days'.
